items.headline: DC warns hospitals against denying initial treatment to snakebite victims
items.blurb: Dakshina Kannada Deputy Commissioner Darshan H V warned hospitals of legal action for denying immediate snakebite care; the district recorded 365 cases in 2023 and 527 through September 2025.

items.headline: BJP MLA condemns police handling of student protest over Dasara exams
items.blurb: Mangaluru City South MLA Vedavyas Kamath condemned police handling of ABVP-backed students protesting degree exams scheduled around Dasara, alleging rough treatment including of a student who chanted Bharat Mata Ki Jai, and said he secured the students' release after intervening at the station.

items.headline: MCC to take up drive from today to issue pending birth and death certificates
items.blurb: Mangaluru City Corporation will run a drive from October 14 to October 17 to issue pending birth and death certificates, with applicants told to book slots through the corporation’s online portal.

items.headline: Pourakarmikas demand allotment of housing sites
items.blurb: Sanitation workers in Mangaluru demanded Mangaluru City Corporation allot housing sites previously identified for pourakarmikas.

items.headline: Tourist taxi drivers reiterate demand for 8-minute free pick and drop facility at airport
items.blurb: Taxi associations at Mangaluru International Airport renewed demands for an eight-minute free pick-up and drop window and protested a ₹50 entry fee for commercial vehicles.

items.headline: Report sought on delay in UGD project in Kundapur
items.blurb: Balakrishna ordered a report on the 11-year delay in Kundapur’s ₹56.54 crore underground drainage project.

items.headline: 2 die of electrocution while fishing in DK
items.blurb: Bharath (28) of Kalmadka and Ramesh alias Ganesh (36) of Guruvayanakere died of electrocution while fishing with a minor at Holakere in Kalmadka, Sullia taluk, on October 12; Bellare police registered a case against plantation owner Madhusoodan Bhat for an alleged unauthorised electric connection.

items.headline: Udupi gets state's first 'fully literate district' tag
items.blurb: The state government declared Udupi Karnataka’s first fully literate district with literacy above 95%.

items.headline: FIGHTING WATER CRISIS THE WAY NITK DOES IT
items.blurb: NITK Surathkal has operationalised NITKere, a 30-million-litre rainwater harvesting reservoir created in 2025 and linked by an 850-metre pipeline to a one-million-litre-per-day purification plant commissioned in February 2026, presented as a model for institutional water security during summer shortages.

items.headline: Bhatkal faces rainfall deficit, inflow into dam declines
items.blurb: Bhatkal in Uttara Kannada is seeing a sharply deficient monsoon versus its normal annual rainfall of 4,152.3 mm, with falling inflow into the Kadavinakatte dam raising concerns for drinking water, about 2,000–2,500 hectares of paddy, and livestock fodder.

items.headline: Shivakumar seeks report on police action at SIR protest
items.blurb: Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar sought a report on police action against Bengaluru protesters opposing the special intensive revision of electoral rolls, saying peaceful protest must be allowed; Home Minister Priyank Kharge said police were told to keep order without creating fear.

items.headline: Ambulance crew to go on strike again seeking annual increment
items.blurb: Suvarna Karnataka Arogya Kavacha (108) employees will suspend ambulance services from Wednesday midnight demanding annual increments, a shift system, ₹50 lakh insurance and timely salaries affecting about 3,200 drivers and EMTs.

items.headline: K'taka Cabinet to discuss HC verdict on SC/ST quota: Parameshwara
items.blurb: Deputy CM G Parameshwara said the Cabinet would discuss the High Court verdict striking down a 2022 law that raised SC reservation from 15% to 17% and ST from 3% to 7%, and would consider options including approaching the Supreme Court.

items.headline: Court issues gag order on airing videos on Siddaramaiah
items.blurb: A Bengaluru civil court issued an interim injunction restraining YouTube channels from broadcasting defamatory videos about former Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah, including items titled “Karnataka Honey Trap Nexus Part 1” and “Live: Biggest CD Blast in Karnataka Politics”.

items.headline: KPSC probe: SC nod to replace SIT chief
items.blurb: The Supreme Court allowed the Karnataka government to replace DGP Alok Kumar and DIG Divya Gopinath as heads of the High Court-constituted SIT probing the KPSC recruitment scam, directing the state to submit alternative officers to the High Court; Kapil Sibal appeared for the state.

items.headline: 13 children killed in Bihar boat capsize
items.blurb: At least 13 children died when a boat capsized in the Ganga in Vaishali district, Bihar, according to reports from Patna.

items.headline: Resistance will go on, says Rahul after meeting allies
items.blurb: Congress leader and Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi met INDIA bloc members, student leaders and activists in New Delhi to plan continued agitation against the Chief Election Commissioner and the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, telling reporters that resistance would go on.

items.headline: UPI fee rollout put off beyond Deepavali on traders’ appeal
items.blurb: NPCI postponed merchant discount rate charges on UPI beyond Deepavali after traders’ appeals, T.C.A. Sharad Raghavan reports.

items.headline: China says ‘never recognised’ U.T. of Ladakh; India hits back
items.blurb: China opposed the Survey of India standardising names in Ladakh and said it never recognised the Union Territory; India said no denial could change established facts, Suhasini Haidar and Ananth Krishnan report.

items.headline: Hyundai Motor Group to invest $15.5 bn in India by 2032
items.blurb: Hyundai Motor Group chair Euisun Chung discussed with PM Narendra Modi a $15.5 billion India investment plan through 2032 covering EVs, R&D and supply chains.

items.headline: FlyDubai ‘plot’: 2 Maldivian pilots detained
items.blurb: UAE police detained two Maldivian FlyDubai pilots over an alleged plot to hijack and crash a Dubai–Tel Aviv flight.

items.headline: Saudi Arabia strikes oil facility in Yemen’s capital, say Houthis
items.blurb: Houthi forces said Saudi Arabia struck an oil facility in Sanaa and threatened Riyadh airport and Aramco sites.

items.headline: 11 sailors go missing after drone sinks ship off Bulgaria’s coast
items.blurb: Eleven sailors were missing after a drone attack sank a ship off Bulgaria’s coast.

items.headline: Palestinians displaced from refugee camp will not return: Netanyahu
items.blurb: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Palestinians displaced from a refugee camp would not return.

items.headline: Modi holds ‘warm and productive’ talks with Canadian PM
items.blurb: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke by phone with Canadian PM Mark Carney about strengthening bilateral ties, trade and technology; Carney is expected to visit India in December.

items.headline: Gill wins a record fifth ICC PotM award; Shafali, too, tops
items.blurb: Shubman Gill won a record fifth ICC Men’s Player of the Month award and Shafali Verma took the women’s award after Asia Cup performances.

items.headline: India and WI willow-wielders glove up for another blast
items.blurb: India and West Indies meet in Hyderabad one win from sealing the T20I series after Shreyas Iyer’s century and Arshdeep Singh’s three wickets in Indore.

items.headline: Hazlewood bowls Australia to victory
items.blurb: Josh Hazlewood’s bowling helped Australia beat South Africa in a limited-overs match.

items.headline: Yuvraj appointed Delhi Capitals assistant and batting coach
items.blurb: Yuvraj Singh joined Delhi Capitals as assistant and batting coach for the 2027 IPL under head coach Sourav Ganguly.

items.headline: Goalkeeper Pathak returns, Asiad core retained for ACT
items.blurb: Hockey selectors retained the Asian Games core and recalled goalkeeper Pathak for the Asian Champions Trophy squad.
